# Woodmont Way

<!-- Generated by examples/woodmont-portfolio/build.ts from woodmont-way/facts.json. Edit the JSON and rebuild. -->

**Type:** Garden-style luxury rental community (multifamily)  
**Location:** West Windsor, Mercer County, NJ: off Meadow Road just west of US Route 1, behind MarketFair, along Canal Pointe Boulevard

A 443-unit, 13-building garden-style rental community completed in 2022, with a two-story clubhouse, a resort-style pool with cabana, detached garages, and a private patio or balcony for every home.

## Estimates

Each of these is a modelling assumption, not a published number.

| Assumption | Value | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Residential stories | 4 stories | **Estimate.** Not published. The pool-view photo and the aerial rendering show four floors of windows on most buildings; the entrance rendering shows three above grade on a sloping corner. Modelled as 4 on every residential building. Density check: 4 stories over the OSM footprints gives about 1,820 gross SF per unit, high for garden apartments, so some buildings may be 3 stories (or the OSM outlines include overhangs). This is the largest uncertainty in the scene; a per-building correction goes in storiesByWay in woodmont-way/build.ts. |
| Floor-to-floor height | 3.05 m | **Estimate.** 10 ft: the published 9-ft ceilings plus about 1 ft of wood-frame floor structure. |
| Residential roof | hip | **Estimate.** Hip roofs with dormers are visible in the renderings and photos; the pitch is not published. |
| Roof pitch | 30 deg | **Estimate.** Read by eye from the entrance rendering and pool photo. |
| Eave overhang | 0.45 m | **Estimate.** Typical for this construction type; not published. |
| Exterior wall thickness | 0.3 m | **Estimate.** Wood frame with siding and brick base; not published. |
| Garage and maintenance building height | 3.2 m | **Estimate.** One story, read from the aerial rendering. |
| Clubhouse floor-to-floor height | 3.66 m | **Estimate.** 12 ft, typical for amenity space; not published. |
| Public street paving width (Canal Pointe Blvd, Meadow Rd, Wheeler Way, Emmons Dr, Farber Rd) | 11 m | **Estimate.** Two lanes with shoulders; OSM stores centrelines only. |
| Internal drive aisle width | 7.3 m | **Estimate.** 24 ft two-way aisle along the OSM service-road centrelines. |
| Parking stall depth | 5.5 m | **Estimate.** 18 ft perpendicular stall. Stall strips are placed on both sides of each aisle segment wherever they clear every building, the pool and the deck; the real striping is not published. |
| Parking stall width | 2.74 m | **Estimate.** 9 ft; used only to estimate the stall count from strip length. |
| Pool deck width around the pool | 6 m | **Estimate.** Read by eye from the pool-view photo; not published. |
| Cabana footprint | 9 x 4.5 m at the north end of the pool deck | **Estimate.** The pool photo shows an open pergola-style cabana at one end of the pool; size and which end are estimates. |
| Site outline | 8 m | **Estimate.** No parcel geometry was reachable. The site polygon is the convex hull of the mapped buildings, pool and drives, pushed out 8 m; its area is compared with the published 23 acres in the scene summary. |
| Units per floor (typical building) | 10 units | **Estimate.** 443 units shared by footprint area: this footprint is 8.9% of the residential footprint area, about 39.5 units over 4 stories, so 10 per floor, 5 on each side of a central corridor (the north five between the stair halls). Unit mix and plans are not published. |
| Corridor width | 1.8 m | **Estimate.** Double-loaded corridor, typical width; not published. |
| Stair halls | 3.2 m | **Estimate.** Two stair halls, 3.2 m wide, at the ends of the north side, with a switchback flight per storey (Pascal's stair tool sizes the risers). Stair positions and widths are not published. |
| Balcony size | 3.0 x 1.8 m, one per unit, with a 1.8 m sliding door | **Estimate.** Read by eye from the photos; every unit gets one to match the published 'patio or balcony' for every home (ground floor: patios). |
| Window rhythm | two 0.9 x 1.6 m double-hung windows per unit on the long facade, two more on each south end unit's gable wall, one per stair hall, 0.6 m sill | **Estimate.** Read by eye from the photos; the real elevations are richer (bays, paired windows, dormers). |
| Garage and maintenance roof pitch | 22 deg | **Estimate.** Gable roofs read from the aerial rendering; pitch by eye. |
| Garage and maintenance eaves | 0.3 m | **Estimate.** Not published. |
| Garage and maintenance wall thickness | 0.25 m | **Estimate.** Not published. |
| Pool depth | 1.4 m | **Estimate.** Typical residential pool depth; not published. |
| Door sizes | unit entry doors 0.95 m wide; building entries 1.8 x 2.3 m glass at both corridor ends; balcony doors 1.8 x 2.1 m sliding | **Estimate.** Typical sizes; not published. |
| Clubhouse roof | hip, same pitch as the apartments | **Estimate.** The clubhouse roof in the aerial rendering is a cluster of hips and gables; one hip over its bounding rectangle stands in for it. |

Year built, Building type, Detached garages, Location, Residential roof, Approved unit mix, Affordable units (approved)

## Conflicts and notes

- The approved unit mix in Community News (114 + 290 + 29) sums to 433, not 443; the 443 total is repeated by every later source, so the mix is context only and is not used in the model.
- Planet Princeton (March 2021) says 433 units; Real Estate NJ, Multi-Housing News and JLL all say 443. 443 is used.
- The address appears as 200 Emmons Drive (Multi-Housing News, 2020), 100 Woodmont Circle (Real Estate NJ, 2021) and 100 Woodstone Circle (JLL, 2023); Woodstone was the project's approval-stage name.
- Multi-Housing News (2020) said "some units" would have a patio or balcony; the 2021 leasing coverage says all homes do. The later, as-built wording is used.
- The task brief named woodmont.com as Woodmont's site; that domain belongs to The Woodmont Company of Fort Worth, Texas. Woodmont Properties (New Jersey) is woodmontproperties.com.
